updates.title: Major UI Redesign
updates.description: Complete redesign of the dashboard with new navigation structure, improved dark mode support, and faster page load times.

updates.title: Email System Improvements
updates.description: Fixed email delivery issues for members with non-latin characters in names, improved retry mechanism, and added better error logging.

updates.title: OAuth Provider Updates
updates.description: Updated authentication flow for improved security, added Google OAuth, and fixed token refresh issues.
